question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

The book is **more better than **the previous one.
solution:
The correct answer is '**better than**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**better**" is the comparative form of the adjective "good" and does not require the addition of "more" because it is inherently a comparative word.
 
• The phrase "**more better**" is grammatically incorrect as it creates redundancy.
 
• **Option 1: "much better than"** is grammatically correct but does not precisely replace the highlighted part in the sentence structure.
 
• **Options 2, 3,** and **5** are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The book is **better than**__ the previous one."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "better from"** is incorrect because the preposition "from" does not work with comparative adjectives like "better."
 
• **Option 3: "more good than"** is incorrect because "good" does not take "more" in its comparative form; the correct form is "better."
